workItem.title: Qualify Quint-first authoring across requirements, S.I.R., and coordination

requirements.title: Three literate slices typecheck and exercise positive and injected-negative cases under exact tool and source fingerprints. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-001)
requirements.text: Three literate slices typecheck and exercise positive and injected-negative cases under exact tool and source fingerprints. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-001)

requirements.title: Deterministic extraction rejects missing, reordered, duplicate, stale, and hand-edited generated modules. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-001)
requirements.text: Deterministic extraction rejects missing, reordered, duplicate, stale, and hand-edited generated modules. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-001)

requirements.title: Independent domain and architecture reviewers evaluate traceability and readability without relying on author explanation. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-001)
requirements.text: Independent domain and architecture reviewers evaluate traceability and readability without relying on author explanation. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-001)

requirements.title: The producer and S.I.R. child agree on exact model, trace, adapter, implementation, seed, bounds, toolchain, profile, and compiled-contract fingerprints before acceptance. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-001)
requirements.text: The producer and S.I.R. child agree on exact model, trace, adapter, implementation, seed, bounds, toolchain, profile, and compiled-contract fingerprints before acceptance. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-001)

requirements.title: The requirements/evidence, S.I.R.-rule, and coordination-process slices are literate Markdown with ordered named `quint` blocks; prose contains no requirement, action, invariant, evidence obligation, or binding absent from the executable catalogue. (Acceptance: AC-001)
requirements.text: The requirements/evidence, S.I.R.-rule, and coordination-process slices are literate Markdown with ordered named `quint` blocks; prose contains no requirement, action, invariant, evidence obligation, or binding absent from the executable catalogue. (Acceptance: AC-001)

requirements.title: The exact `quint-co/quint-llm-kit` commit and every evaluated file are content-digested, Apache-2.0 attributed, and dispositioned as adopted, adapted, or rejected; no moving installer or branch is executed. (Acceptance: AC-005)
requirements.text: The exact `quint-co/quint-llm-kit` commit and every evaluated file are content-digested, Apache-2.0 attributed, and dispositioned as adopted, adapted, or rejected; no moving installer or branch is executed. (Acceptance: AC-005)

requirements.title: The report evaluates standalone language/modeling/execution skills, witnesses, trace explanations, transition labels, type/listener coverage, Choreo versus plain Quint, and fast-run versus model-checking tiers. (Acceptance: AC-005)
requirements.text: The report evaluates standalone language/modeling/execution skills, witnesses, trace explanations, transition labels, type/listener coverage, Choreo versus plain Quint, and fast-run versus model-checking tiers. (Acceptance: AC-005)

requirements.title: The coordination slice covers retry, stale observation, lost update, double apply, ordering, deadlock, safety, liveness, and convergence; the S.I.R. slice defines stable actions and observable states without duplicating interpreter logic. (Acceptance: AC-006)
requirements.text: The coordination slice covers retry, stale observation, lost update, double apply, ordering, deadlock, safety, liveness, and convergence; the S.I.R. slice defines stable actions and observable states without duplicating interpreter logic. (Acceptance: AC-006)

requirements.title: Measurements bind exact dependency identities and report source/generated/IR sizes, typecheck/run/verify time, diagnostics, reproducibility, upgrade sensitivity, semantic-diff usefulness, and reviewer readability findings. (Acceptance: AC-003)
requirements.text: Measurements bind exact dependency identities and report source/generated/IR sizes, typecheck/run/verify time, diagnostics, reproducibility, upgrade sensitivity, semantic-diff usefulness, and reviewer readability findings. (Acceptance: AC-003)

requirements.title: The proposed profile is closed and versioned, separates production meaning from finite bounds, refuses unsupported constructs, and derives stable IDs from explicit typed catalogue data rather than compiler node IDs. (Acceptance: AC-001, AC-002)
requirements.text: The proposed profile is closed and versioned, separates production meaning from finite bounds, refuses unsupported constructs, and derives stable IDs from explicit typed catalogue data rather than compiler node IDs. (Acceptance: AC-001, AC-002)

requirements.title: The proposed language-neutral compiled contract contains only stable integration identities, source locations, relationships, verification profiles, bounded domains, digests, and compatibility metadata; it contains no arbitrary Quint expression encoding. (Acceptance: AC-001)
requirements.text: The proposed language-neutral compiled contract contains only stable integration identities, source locations, relationships, verification profiles, bounded domains, digests, and compatibility metadata; it contains no arbitrary Quint expression encoding. (Acceptance: AC-001)

requirements.title: Success emits an explicit candidate verdict and exact fingerprint manifest but changes no authority; Q2 remains blocked until a separately reviewed ADR-0077 amendment accepts the authoring and fingerprint contract. (Acceptance: AC-004)
requirements.text: Success emits an explicit candidate verdict and exact fingerprint manifest but changes no authority; Q2 remains blocked until a separately reviewed ADR-0077 amendment accepts the authoring and fingerprint contract. (Acceptance: AC-004)

decisions.title: Q1 evaluates exact upstream `lmt` commit `62fe18f…`; generated targets and a source-map manifest are bound to ordered fence bytes, and missing/reordered/duplicate/stale/edited cases must fail.
decisions.decision: Q1 evaluates exact upstream `lmt` commit `62fe18f…`; generated targets and a source-map manifest are bound to ordered fence bytes, and missing/reordered/duplicate/stale/edited cases must fail.

decisions.title: Q1 pins Quint v0.32.0 and exact platform asset digests. A different version or digest is a distinct candidate, never an automatic upgrade.
decisions.decision: Q1 pins Quint v0.32.0 and exact platform asset digests. A different version or digest is a distinct candidate, never an automatic upgrade.

decisions.title: The coordination slice uses plain Quint. Choreo is explicitly rejected for this slice after a dependency/readability comparison, not ignored.
decisions.decision: The coordination slice uses plain Quint. Choreo is explicitly rejected for this slice after a dependency/readability comparison, not ignored.

decisions.title: The committed witness contract is a stable action sequence plus expected observable states and exact fingerprints; it contains no adapter implementation or copied combat rule.
